title: 🔆🔅Tehran- October 12 - Gholamhossein Mohseni Ejei, Head of the Iranian Judiciary, made remarks regarding recent terrorist attacks.
text:
🔆🔅Tehran- October 12 - Gholamhossein Mohseni Ejei, Head of the Iranian Judiciary, made remarks regarding recent terrorist attacks."

""
"SOT1, Gholamhossein Mohseni-Ejei, Iran's Judiciary Chief, (Farsi)-(00:05 - 00:47): "In recent weeks and days, these 'blind-hearted, hireling' terrorists, acting as tools of imperialist power to serve their masters, have resorted to terrorism. In their false belief, they aim to destabilize the security of a corner of our country and our nation as a whole. But they are delusional; they are truly 'blind-hearted' people who cannot see, cannot hear, and do not understand that when they resort to terrorism, our people become even more cohesive.""

"SOT2, Gholamhossein Mohseni-Ejei, Iran's Judiciary Chief, (Farsi)-(00:52 - 01:41): "These terrorists, the enemies themselves, or ill-wishers, whether internal or external, should know that the Islamic Republic of Iran is more determined and more steadfast than ever. Under no circumstances will it back down or surrender to today's imperialist powers, the United States and the Zionist regime. Rather, by the grace of the Lord, just as the will of these revolutionary and faithful people has prevailed over them until this day, from now on as well, God will surely include them in His victory, God willing. As always, we will see with our own eyes the dissolution and downfall of these [powers].
